thread:
maria: Heads-up — a customer reported that downloading the audit CSV for a tenant with KMS-encrypted fields intermittently fails with a 403. Two separate pain points here: a permission check on KMS causing hard export failures, and CSV rows getting corrupted when streaming pagination splits escaped newlines.

dylan: Can you paste the exact error and a minimal repro?

maria: Backend error: `403 KMS: access denied for key projects/rdw-key/locations/global/keyRings/audit/cryptoKeys/ck1`. Steps: Console → Audit logs → filter tenant=acme-corp → Export CSV (All pages) → job fails after ~30s. Happens only when tenant has events with `sensitive_payload` fields that are encrypted.

audit-bot: export_job created id=exp_0a1b2c status=FAILED code=KMS_ACCESS_DENIED

eli: Quick thoughts: (1) UI should run a preflight that verifies the caller's role has both `audit.export` and KMS decrypt scope (service principal mapping) before launching long-running exports. (2) Export pipeline must never crash if a single row can't be decrypted — mark columns as `<redacted:needs_kms>` and continue.

samir: There's also a streaming edge-case: we chunk CSV by pages and sometimes split an escaped newline inside a JSON payload, producing a broken CSV row in the final file. Options: always base64-encode the JSON payload column, or use a stable escaping strategy and ensure we never cut mid-escape. I'll prepare an exporter change proposal.

kate: UX idea: before starting export show a "Preview" modal that renders the first 50 rows and flags columns that will be redacted with a tooltip `Requires KMS decrypt permission`. Also show a clear warning banner if some events will be excluded due to schema_version mismatch.

maria: Also need a schema validation column. If events have `schema_version` mismatch with the current export schema, include `schema_version` and `validation_errors` columns. Fail only for infra errors; emit validation warnings as a JSONL sidecar so customers can programmatically check.

dylan: I'll scope a preflight API `/v1/audit_exports/validate` that returns `{ok:boolean, blocked:boolean, warnings:[string]}` and a reason when blocked. That way UI can show deterministic messages and not launch doomed exports.

eli: RBAC note: currently the Console `viewer` role maps to `audit.viewer` but not `audit.export`. We should add an explicit `audit.export` permission in the role editor and a checkbox "Allow audit exports (includes KMS access checks)". Update docs accordingly.

samir: Filing PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/1234 — adds `--escape-mode=base64` option to exporter and a fallback to mark redacted cells instead of failing.

maria: Owners: @eli -> preflight API + RBAC doc update; @samir -> exporter streaming + redaction fallback; @kate -> UI preview modal & warning copy. Can we get rough ETAs?

eli: 2w for API and docs.

samir: 4 days to ship the exporter change (pending review and a small infra rollout window).

kate: 1 week for mocks and copy, 2 weeks for implementation (QA dependent).

maria: I'll draft a customer-facing KB that explains export redaction, KMS permission steps, and the preflight validation behavior. Looping in support to prep standard response text.

support: Thanks — tagging SRE for throttling/backoff concerns and to get the export retry policy documented.

audit-bot: export_job exp_0a1b2c status=RETRYING attempts=1

maria: For the KB, include these items: how to grant decrypt permission to the export service principal, how to interpret the `validation_errors` column, and a snippet customers can use to call the preflight API.

dylan: Example preflight curl (for KB):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://console.api.redwood.ai/v1/audit_exports/validate \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","filters":{"time_range":"30d"}}'
```

eli: Also add a Console UX pattern: if preflight returns `blocked:true` show the exact missing permission and a one-click docs link that explains how to grant it.

samir: I'll coordinate the exporter rollout with infra so we can opt in a single region and measure integrity of CSVs.

maria: Thanks everyone — assigning owners in the ticket now. I'll paste the KB draft in #support-docs when ready. :thumbsup:
